findings.title: Runs ended in failure
findings.fact: 1 of 7 run(s) recorded the outcome failed.
findings.impact: 1 run(s) stopped before completing their stage

findings.title: Reviews withhold their verdict
findings.fact: 6 of 6 verdicts are WITHHELD (100 %); 3 of them had code files not reviewed, 3 would have been APPROVE (withheld_from). They cover 6 PR head(s) on 1 PR(s). Guardrail: 3 (code cut, ADR-0038: 3; CI evidence, ADR-0026: 0); anomaly: 3 (REQUEST_CHANGES on unseen code: 0; unknown cause: 3; fallback answered a prompt cut to the primary's budget: 0). Answered by: not recorded 6; input budget 6300 tokens.
findings.impact: 6 review(s) ended without a usable verdict; a person has to review

lever.summary: Reviews are withheld on code the prompt budget or the CI evidence leaves unseen

findings.title: PRs not approved after several reviews
findings.fact: 1 PR(s) have their last 3+ verdicts without an APPROVE: #9 (6).

findings.title: Review diffs are cut by design (ADR-0038)
findings.fact: 3 of 6 reviews saw a truncated diff; median 3 code file(s) not reviewed, input budget 6300 tokens. Guardrail (WITHHELD, ADR-0038): 3; anomaly: 0 (APPROVE on a cut diff, impossible since ADR-0038: 0; other verdict: 0).
findings.hypothesis: The guardrail worked as designed: approval is withheld on code the review did not see (ADR-0038). The lever is the provider or its input budget (review_max_input_tokens, ADR-0025).

gaps.title: Merge is journaled only from item-closed.yml on
gaps.detail: A merge or a closing is recorded (item.closed) only for items closed after item-closed.yml existed, and only in this repository; the Pipelines page asks GitHub for merged_at in the browser for the rest.

gaps.title: Closings before the closing journal are not recorded
gaps.detail: Only items closed or merged after item-closed.yml was merged have an item.closed event. An item closed before it that last escalated still reads as escalated: the dashboard does not infer a closing from GitHub or from silence. The Pipelines page re-checks pull requests live.

gaps.title: Running state is not observable
gaps.detail: A record is written when its run completes, so a run in progress never appears; the latest state of an item can be older than GitHub.

gaps.title: Runs outside any work-item trace
gaps.detail: 7 run(s) have no trace index: they appear in Investigation but not in Pipelines.

gaps.title: Duration trend not computable
gaps.detail: Fewer than 3 runs in one of the two latest 7-day periods for: review. No degradation is reported for them — that is not the same as no degradation.
